method.summary: Raw HTTP capture of the public pages and their referenced images (curl, desktop Chrome UA, no login). The T3 preview browser failed to open (host missing libnspr4/libnss3/libgbm and others); the standalone headless fallback is reserved for rendered-page screenshots. No account, dashboard or upload data was available, so upload contents, embed settings and draft state are NOT observed.

pages_site.title: KNOTZAXXON // ASSAULT ON THE IRON FORTRESS

findings: Itch cover, Itch header banner and Pages og-image are byte-identical (sha256 b5ce2b01...). The art predates the authored environment kit: an empty, dark deck with no ship, enemy, fire or sector variety.
The cover is 1200x630 (1.9:1) where itch asks for 315:250. Itch's 315x250 centre crop cuts the wordmark to 'NOTZAXXON' and clips the copy (observed in live-images/itch-cover-315x250c.png).
data.json lists zero screenshots; itch recommends 3-5. The sidebar shows only the cover again.
Only one tag ('shooter') is public. Tags are set in the itch dashboard (account-only action).

The listing is classified 'A downloadable game' but has no visible download; play is an external link. An in-page HTML5 upload (primary's P2 archive) would remove the off-site hop. Whether to switch, and the embed/viewport/mobile settings, are account-only decisions.
Do not assume itch uploads match Pages: no uploads are publicly visible, so their content and version are unobserved.

verbatim: Cover images should respect a 315:250 aspect ratio.
315x250 is a minimum, but it's best to include a larger image with the same aspect ratio, like 630x500.
Screenshots can be any size, it's recommended to upload between 3 and 5 of them.
It can be a semi-transparent PNG, it could be an animated GIF (some particle effects around the title letters?).
When a banner is uploaded to an itch.io page, it replaces the title otherwise shown just above the description.
itch_banner_background.dimensions: None published. Any banner size here is a design choice, not an itch requirement.

verbatim: The ZIP file should not contain more than 1,000 individual files after extraction.
The size of all the extracted content should not be greater than 500MB.
The size any single extracted file should not be greater than 200MB.
The maximum length of a file name including path should not be greater than 240 characters long.
The ZIP file must contain a file called `index.html`
itch_html5.notes: Embed-in-page needs author-chosen viewport dimensions; optional auto fullscreen button; 'Mobile Friendly' toggle gives mobile visitors click-to-launch fullscreen.

verbatim: Your image should be a PNG, JPG, or GIF file under 1 MB in size.
we recommend a size of at least 640 by 320 pixels

open_graph.note: 1200x630 is the widely used summary_large_image/OG size; Open Graph itself sets no pixel size. Absolute URLs are already used.

preserve_previous.rule: The current live itch cover/banner and Pages link art are kept byte-for-byte in the raw capture above; nothing is uploaded or deleted by this worker. Replacing listing images, tags or uploads is an account-only action for the owner.
preserve_previous.public_repo_art_policy: New link art is added under public/brand/ with new filenames; the old public/og-image.png and social-preview.png stay so existing cached links keep resolving.

deliverables.index_html: og:image and twitter:image now point at brand/og-1200x630.png; legacy public/og-image.png and social-preview.png retained

legacy.public/og-image.png: superseded, retained for cached links; unreferenced by index.html
legacy.scripts/brand/render-link-art.cjs: legacy generator for the retained cards and icons; superseded by scripts/brand/launch/compose.cjs; re-running would overwrite the legacy cards
